name: Slack
description: Send alerts to a Slack channel (using webhooks).

USE_SLACK.help: Enable sending alerts to a Slack channel.
USE_SLACK.label: Use Slack

SLACK_RETRY_IF_LIMITED.help: Retry to send the request if Slack API is rate limiting us (may consume a lot of resources).
SLACK_RETRY_IF_LIMITED.label: Retry if limited by Slack

SLACK_ALERT_IPS.help: Only notify denied requests from these IPs/networks (separated with spaces). Leave empty to notify every denied request.
SLACK_ALERT_IPS.label: Alert IPs

SLACK_UNLISTED_THRESHOLD.help: When SLACK_ALERT_IPS is set, send one notification for each IP not in the list that is denied this many times within SLACK_UNLISTED_PERIOD (0 to disable).
SLACK_UNLISTED_THRESHOLD.label: Unlisted IPs threshold

SLACK_UNLISTED_PERIOD.help: Period in seconds used to count denied requests per IP not in SLACK_ALERT_IPS.
SLACK_UNLISTED_PERIOD.label: Unlisted IPs period

SLACK_BAN_ALERT.help: When SLACK_ALERT_IPS is set, send one escalated notification when a watched IP gets banned (added to the ban list), and mute the per-request block alerts for it while the ban lasts.
SLACK_BAN_ALERT.label: Alert on watched IP ban

SLACK_BAN_MENTION.help: Optional mention prepended to the ban notification only (e.g. <!here> or <!channel> for Slack). Leave empty to disable.
SLACK_BAN_MENTION.label: Ban alert mention
